description: P1 walks forward ~3s (frames 0-180 @60fps physics), jumps twice while grounded (press+release near frame 190 and frame 230, each held 6 frames), then walks backward ~2s (frames 260-380) before stopping. Baseline smoke test: exercises move+jump input playback end to end with no forgiveness-window edge cases (both jumps land comfortably inside the grounded window) - used by docs/verify/harness-VERIFY.md.
